title: Taylor Swift & Travis Kelce’s gift helps feed Nashville families
summary_full: Prior to their wedding at Madison Square Garden, Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce donated $26 million to various charities. One of the notable beneficiaries was The Store, a Nashville non-profit aimed at combating food insecurity. Due to rising food costs, The Store had paused the admission of new families prior to receiving the donation. The couple's charitable efforts supported 20 local and national organizations, reflecting their deep community ties.
